purpose: Matched three-seed six-epoch exploratory comparison of latest-target anchoring plus zero-initialized head; no other architecture or budget change
initialization: Same dedicated seeded Xavier body as v1; consume the same RNG draws, then zero scalar head weight and bias
shuffle: one full permutation per epoch; dedicated CPU generator seeded seed+1000
selection: lowest validation MAE in original units; strict improvement; earliest epoch wins ties
test_policy: Seal every seed after validation selection before scoring the previously inspected test period; report every seed and both baselines; no reserved-tail use
stopping: Exactly six epochs per seed; numerical failure aborts and is retained; no outcome-dependent extension
limitations: Old test already inspected: exploratory comparison, not new confirmation
Overlapping forecasts are dependent; no IID significance claim
Anchoring and zero-head initialization are a combined intervention; their individual effects are not isolated
No tuning or budget extension after seeing outcomes
No forecast-speed, financial or deployment claim
comparison: Report every paired seed against the fixed v1 run and persistence on validation and old-test MAE/RMSE; no selection of a test winner
initial_candidate: Zero head implies persistence exactly in raw-output arithmetic; checkpoint selection still uses trained epochs 1..6 as in v1
